en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet, tree‑lined street with early 20th‑century European buildings. On the left is a long two‑storey house or official building with simple stucco façade, stone base, sash windows and ornate wall‑mounted lanterns. In the distance on the right stands a freestanding villa with a steep hipped roof, tower‑like corner and decorative façade set behind a garden. Bare trees line the wide, mostly empty dirt roadway. A uniformed man walks near the center, while a small child stands at the right edge. The scene feels residential and slightly formal, with no visible printed captions or signage.
